image_description: A modern interior staircase featuring a curved glass balustrade system. The primary visual element is a thick, light-colored wooden handrail that curves smoothly along the incline of the stairs. Instead of traditional vertical balusters, the railing is supported by large, transparent glass panels held in place by metal clamps or a continuous metal channel. In the background, another level of the building is visible with perforated metal flooring and ceiling lights.
